title: DO LARGE LANGUAGE MODELS WALK THEIR TALK? MEASURING THE GAP BETWEEN IMPLICIT ASSOCIATIONS, SELF-REPORT, AND BEHAVIORAL ALTRUISM

bias_targets.methodology: Using an adapted Implicit Association Test (LLM-IAT) to measure the probability of models categorizing positive words as 'other-interest' and negative words as 'self-interest'.
Including reverse-coded items in the 15-item LLM Altruism Self-Assessment (LLM-ASA) scale to detect a model's tendency to endorse positive self-descriptions regardless of actual behavior.
